Glance 2026.07.23.2 improves text and web previews, runtime stability, and installation behavior.

## Highlights

- Preview local web documents with switchable Preview and Code modes.
- Render text and source files through Scintilla and Lexilla with improved large-file handling and additional themes.
- Check for new releases directly from the About page.
- Reduce idle resource usage and improve interactive preview stability.
- Upgrade while Glance is running and optionally remove user data during uninstall.
